verdict.rationale: Privacy posture and telemetry opt-out are fair questions for a SaaS fraud-detection platform like Sift, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no setting, policy or mechanism for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. The docs instead describe sending user event data to Sift via the REST API and JS snippet, and the sandbox only isolates test data from production scores; it is not a tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
